identityLinkage.invariants: tenantId propagates through S3 path, Redis jobs, and findings; jobId != runId != reportId != inspectionId.

endpoints.purpose: Async inspection job dispatch with idempotencyKey
Complete structured analysis and report draft retrieval

redisAsyncJobContract.queueImplementation: RedisJobQueue (FIFO LPUSH / BRPOP) with InMemoryJobQueue fallback
redisAsyncJobContract.repositoryImplementation: RedisJobRepository (JSON serialization with 24h TTL) with InMemoryJobRepository fallback
redisAsyncJobContract.retryPolicy: Bounded exponential backoff with jitter (max 3 retries, transient errors only)

securityGuards: Path traversal sanitization (rejection of .., absolute paths, URL schemes)

tablesRequired: ai_analysis_runs (run_id PK, inspection_id, tenant_id, status, model_name, model_version, execution_ms, created_at)
ai_findings (finding_id PK, run_id FK, evidence_id, finding_type, confidence, severity, explanation, compliance_status, detection_polygon, created_at)
ai_report_drafts (report_id PK, run_id FK, inspection_id, tenant_id, review_state, executive_summary, risk_score, created_at)
ai_officer_reviews (review_id PK, finding_id FK, officer_id, review_status, officer_notes, reviewed_at)
ai_audit_trail (audit_id PK, entity_id, action, from_state, to_state, actor, reason, timestamp)
postgresPersistenceContract.spatialFormat: PostGIS geometry(Polygon, 4326) or normalized xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax columns [0, 1]

allowedStates: OFFICER_CONFIRMED (verified on-site and confirmed by human officer)
OFFICER_DISMISSED (inspected on-site and dismissed with notes)
officerReviewContract.safetyInvariant: AI NEVER approves or rejects NOC compliance. Zero detections != compliant.
